record.title: Nagoya selects AI consumer-hotline project and presents closed-system workflow
record.summary: Nagoya City selected a consumer-affairs hotline AI demonstration project, implemented by Core Co., in a 1 September project-decision notice. At an October 22 committee meeting, the city presented a closed-system concept for call transcription, structured case records, prompts for missing information and suggested advice. Selection is established; procurement details, field deployment and measured service outcomes are not. The presentation lists accuracy, knowledge freshness, sensitive-information protection and cost-effectiveness as unresolved issues.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: Nagoya City presented an AI-assisted consumer hotline concept at Japan’s Consumer Commission meeting on 22 October 2026. Its submission describes a closed-system workflow for call transcription, structuring consultation records, prompting counselors to collect missing information and suggesting advice.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: Nagoya’s 1 September project-decision notice selected a consumer-affairs hotline initiative to use AI to address counselor staffing and expertise-transfer pressures, with Core Co. as implementing firm. The 22 October committee submission describes the proposed closed-system workflow. Selection is established; deployment and service outcomes are not.

claims.label: NOT_ESTABLISHED
claims.text: The presentation reports no accuracy, response-time, service-quality, workload or safety evaluation. It lists accuracy, knowledge freshness, sensitive-information protection and cost-effectiveness as outstanding issues.

evidence_gaps.description: The city selected the demonstration project on 1 September, but no procurement details, dated field deployment or operating status are established in the inspected sources.
No evaluation of accuracy, response time, service quality, counselor workload, data retention/access safeguards or sensitive-case handling is reported.

brief.importance_rationale: If adopted with effective safeguards, AI assistance for a municipal consumer hotline could affect how public advice services handle intake and preserve counselor expertise. The proposal is local and has no measured service outcome, so its consequence remains bounded.
limitations: The workflow is illustrated in a presentation; no model/vendor, validation, measured service result or field trial is specified.
The city lists accuracy, knowledge currency, sensitive-information protection and cost-effectiveness as unresolved deployment issues.
The “closed-system” description does not specify data retention, access controls or human-review boundaries.
The project was selected for demonstration support, but the inspected material does not establish whether or when the system entered field operation.

technical.claimed_result: The city presented a workflow concept for AI-assisted call transcription, consultation record structuring, missing-information prompts and advice suggestions. No system evaluation or service result was reported.
technical.compute_or_cost: No model, vendor, compute configuration or project budget is specified. Cost-effectiveness is listed as an open implementation issue.
technical.demonstrated_result: Nagoya City’s 1 September project-decision notice lists the AI consumer hotline project and Core Co.; an official 22 October committee submission describes its proposed workflow. No operating result is reported.
technical.implementation_status: Selected demonstration project; Core Co. is listed as implementer. Field deployment and operating status are not established.
technical.mechanism: The proposed system would transcribe calls, organize case fields, prompt for missing facts and suggest advice based on prior responses or knowledge. The submission describes a closed system but does not fully define human-review or data-handling controls.

technical.reproducibility: No deployed system or evaluation artifact was supplied.
technical.strongest_baseline: The presentation gives no measured pre-deployment service baseline.
